summary: Iteration 99: Tested Admin Panel CRUD operations - User hard delete, password change, role change (Editor/Admin da Empresa), and Company hard delete. All 12 backend tests passed. Frontend verified: edit modal shows password field with 'Deixe vazio para não alterar' placeholder, role selector with Editor/Admin da Empresa options, delete confirmation shows 'Excluir permanentemente' text.
critical_code_review_comments: User hard delete implemented correctly: db.users.delete_one() + db.user_sessions.delete_many()
Company hard delete implemented correctly: deletes company + all users in company + their sessions
Password change in update_user: accepts 'password' field, hashes with bcrypt, min 6 chars validation
Role change: super_admin can change to any role, company_admin can toggle between editor/company_admin
Edit modal correctly shows email as read-only when editing existing user
Password field placeholder 'Deixe vazio para não alterar' correctly indicates optional password change
seed_data_creation: Test users and companies created/deleted during tests (cleanup performed)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin Panel CRUD fully functional: 1) Users can be permanently deleted (hard delete), 2) Password can be changed when editing user (leave empty to keep current), 3) Role can be changed between Editor and Admin da Empresa. Company delete also removes all users in that company.
